title: Route provider no-seat responses to the capacity workflow

outcomes.statement: A classified provider no-seat response atomically enters the existing blocked-no-seat capacity workflow while other failures remain distinct.
outcomes.demo: Return a provider no-seat response and verify one legal blocked_no_seat transition, no failed transition, and visibility to capacity recovery.

uncertainties.statement: US-063 must first establish the invitation execution seam that this classification extends.
uncertainties.resolution: US-063 is dev_done at source commit 2263bee9009a8e6716e68963a43f56e2880c87d3 and establishes the automated invitation worker, durable connector-call observation, advisory-lock recovery, and atomic success-finalization seams that US-064 extends.

actuals.root_cause: Measured from the approved readiness commit 83462bd at 2026-09-08T02:46:04Z through the terminal evidence at 2026-09-08T06:00:07Z. Readiness is the 22-minute approval-to-plan interval ending at a528da7; the remaining 167 minutes are allocated by durable cutoffs: started-to-initial reviewed source 03ab54d (83 implementation), source-to-adversarial evidence (15 focused verification), first evidence through the cohesive post-campaign repair d8a8019 (54 review), and final immutable-source check plus campaign (15 integration). Reproduce changed_files with git diff --name-only authority/us-064-base..d8a80197a97691d5c2c57f76f1ffc2f7b3725900 (33) and commits with git rev-list --count authority/us-064-base..d8a80197a97691d5c2c57f76f1ffc2f7b3725900 (9). Nine review/fix loops covered exact classification, atomic routing, recovery evidence, adversarial failure handling, database baseline typing, mutation accountability, dispatcher planning, append-only grant evidence, and the aggregate-campaign repair plus re-review. Two cache-cleared authoritative campaigns consumed 569 seconds, rounded to 9 minutes: the first was invalidated after 166 seconds with every shard failure aggregated, while the final 403-second run passed all 12 measured shards. The 85-minute variance over the 104-minute estimate came from the real cross-package route spanning 33 files rather than the expected 6, and 12 mutation shards rather than 1; CHG-057 nevertheless reduced the campaign from US-063's nine stop-at-first attempts to two complete attempts, meeting its US-064 acceptance target.
